computed."softDeletableByAccessGroupIds" OR target."destroyableByAccessGroupIds" IS DISTINCT FROM computed."destroyableByAccessGroupIds" OR target."shareableByAccessGroupIds" IS DISTINCT FROM computed."shareableByAccessGroupIds" OR target."receivableByAccessGroupIds" IS DISTINCT FROM computed."receivableByAccessGroupIds") RETURNING target.id
